word.name: concept header for the concept of taggings with specific tags
word.title: Concept Header for the Concept of Taggings with Specific Tags

conceptHeader.description: A tagging-with-specific-tag is the type whose members are per-tag tagging headers — one per Tag, declaring how events are tagged as that Tag. Each member points at the Tag it is for via an a-tag (preferred) or an e-tag. The member has no target, so the a/e slot is free for the Tag reference (unlike a tagging assertion, where a/e holds the target and the Tag is reached indirectly via a z-tag).
